artifact_observations.reasoning: The beige bottom piece does not logically connect to the green top piece. In a real cassette, these are fused or screwed together as a single unit. Here, they look like two separate objects floating adjacent to each other with a hard, unnatural line separating them.
The text printed on the cassette body is nonsensical and distorted, characteristic of AI generation failing to render legible typography.

The bottom strip features four small square holes that do not correspond to any functional part of a standard cassette tape (which usually has a large rectangular window). This indicates a hallucination of mechanical details.
The spool hubs lack the detailed teeth/gears required to engage with a player mechanism; they appear as smooth, simplified discs.
